entities.name: PMID:27511708
observations: 2017 Skin Research and Technology pilot study of 37 healthy volunteers measuring skin autofluorescence on photo-exposed and photo-protected forearms and serum catalase, SOD, vitamin E, and malondialdehyde.

The abstract reports that serum malondialdehyde negatively correlated with skin autofluorescence intensity in the photo-exposed forearm; correlation coefficient and p-value were not available in the accessed record.
